entries.claim: The pinned Latin Mass data independently corroborate the component's substantive Latin and expose accidental editorial variants for collation.

At None of 2 February the Office sings the short responsory Elégit eam and then the versicle Diffúsa est grátia in lábiis tuis with its response Proptérea benedíxit te Deus in ætérnum; the feast thus applies this verse to Mary. This supports the reading of te and tuis on this feast, not a rule for every use of Psalm 44:3.

The complete 16-word Offertory antiphon has been checked directly on the Benziger Brothers 1962 Editio iuxta typicam page, printed p. 467, leaf n548; the page prints no Alleluia. This states current conformity, not original transcription genesis.
